summary_en: 1,000,000 shares (11.52% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) authorized for repurchase. Maximum acquisition cost ¥1,100M. Execution window 16 July – 30 September 2026. Method: open-market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Rationale: dynamic capital allocation in response to changing business environment.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Papyless Co., Ltd. announced on 15 July 2026 that its board of directors has authorized the acquisition of up to 1,000,000 treasury shares (11.52% of the 8,680,163 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) at a total cost not to exceed ¥1,100 million. The acquisition is to be executed between 16 July and 30 September 2026 using open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, including ToSTNeT-3 off-auction trading. The company states the purpose as executing dynamic capital-allocation policy in response to changing business conditions. The disclosure notes that major shareholder Sega Sammy Holdings has informed the company of its intention to sell all of its holdings in Papyless; depending on the outcome, the company's principal shareholders may change.
